name: Belmond La Residencia
positioning: Official name La Residencia, A Belmond Hotel: a mountainside hotel in Deia, Mallorca, built around 17th-century manor houses with an on-site art gallery and studios
best_for: Travelers drawn to art, history and a village setting in the Mallorcan mountains
Guests who want several on-site dining options, pools and a spa

facts.text: La Residencia is a mountainside hotel in Deia, Mallorca.
The property opened as a hotel in 1984.
Dining is at El Olivo, Restaurante Miro and Tramuntana Grill.
El Olivo serves fine dining Mediterranean cuisine.
The hotel has indoor and outdoor swimming pools.
The hotel has a spa, a gym and tennis courts.
Named accommodation includes the Matthew Williamson Suite, the Miro Suite, the Sheridan Suite and the secluded Villa Robert Graves.
Soller is a 20 minute drive from the hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel has the Sa Tafona art gallery, an art studio and a sculpture studio with a resident artist.
The twin manor houses at the core of the estate date back to the 17th century and were once the home of Cistercian monks.
Tramuntana Grill serves grilled specialties and seafood by the pool.

considerations.text: The hotel is a 45 minute drive from Palma Airport.
WhataHotel notes the secluded mountain location requires transportation to beaches.
